## Modeling Results {#sec-assmt-results}

### Parameter Estimates

Key base-model quantities are summarized in @tbl-reference_points.
Important values used in this report include:

- Steepness: `r round(h, 3)`
- Unfished recruitment proxy (`R0`): `r format(round(R0, 0), big.mark = ',')`
- Mean natural mortality: `r round(M, 3)`

### Time Series

Time-series trajectories for spawning biomass and recruitment across model runs are shown in
@fig-model_timeseries. Terminal-year cross-model values are summarized in @tbl-terminal_status.

### Model Fits

Model-fit diagnostics imported from the 2025 source workflow are retained in the figures
section, including composition and index fit summaries (for example @fig-mod_fit_agg_comp,
@fig-bts_osa (Bottom trawl survey, BTS), @fig-ats_osa (Acoustic-trawl survey, ATS), and
@fig-avo_map_yr (Acoustic vessels of opportunity, AVO).

### Model Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: tbl-admb-header
#| tbl-cap: "Selected ADMB optimization diagnostics from `pm.par` header metadata."
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
par_file <- "/Users/jim/_mymods/noaa-afsc/ebs_pollock/runs/lastyr/pm.par"
if (file.exists(par_file)) {
  ln1 <- readLines(par_file, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
  npar <- as.numeric(sub(".*Number of parameters = ([0-9]+).*", "\\1", ln1))
  obj <- as.numeric(sub(".*Objective function value = ([0-9.eE+-]+).*", "\\1", ln1))
  grad <- as.numeric(sub(".*Maximum gradient component = ([0-9.eE+-]+).*", "\\1", ln1))
  dplyr::tibble(
    metric = c("Number of parameters", "Objective function", "Maximum gradient"),
    value = c(npar, obj, grad)
  )
} else {
  dplyr::tibble(
    metric = "ADMB header",
    value = "pm.par file not found"
  )
}
```
